speaker: Adam

text: Speaking of conflicts, Russia has ramped up its offensive in Ukraine, launching missile and drone strikes. There’s been footage of firefighters battling massive fires in the aftermath.

text: And on the Ukrainian side, they’ve struck back, targeting twenty Russian vessels in the Black Sea, including a number of oil tankers.

text: It’s a significant move. That kind of retaliation can really impact supply chains and the economy in the region.

text: Turning to France, a landmark assisted-dying bill has passed in Parliament, albeit with a narrow margin. It still needs approval from the Constitutional Council.

text: That’s a big step forward for many advocates of the right to die with dignity. But I wonder how it will be received by the public and the legal system.
